operation.summary: A batch of Firebase Crashlytics API requests in one, each a whole request frisket cannot see.
List the events for an issue matching filter criteria, sorted in descending order by timestamp.
Fetch a batch of up to 100 events by name.
Change the state of an issue.
List all notes for a certain issue, sorted in descending order by timestamp.
Create a new note for an issue.
Delete a note by its name.
Change the state of a group of issues.
operation.description: Change the state of a group of issues. This method is not atomic, so partial failures can occur. In the event of a partial failure, the request will fail and you will need to call `GetIssue` to see which issues were not updated.

operation.summary: List all of the available reports.
Get a report with its computed results.
Enqueues a request to permanently remove crash reports associated with the specified user.
operation.description: Enqueues a request to permanently remove crash reports associated with the specified user. All reports belonging to the specified user will be deleted typically within 24 hours of receiving the crash report.
